item.title: BERT Is Just a Single Text Diffusion Step
item.description:
📝 BERT is just a Single Text Diffusion Step October 20, 2025Machine LearningA while back, Google DeepMind unveiled Gemini Diffusion, an experimental language model that generates text using diffusion. I read the paper Large Language Diffusion Models and was surprised to find that discrete language diffusion is just a generalization of masked language modeling (MLM), something we’ve been doing since 2018. Discrete Language Diffusion Models#Diffusion models were first popularized in image generation.
